issues.title: Create new orders once activity/geoms created
issues.body:
Our order-creation process is growing.

The next step is to open the blank new order template in the `Orders` tab.

Here is what we have so far:
1. User selects own/opfor assets
2. User selects `new activity`
3. If necessary, user adds geometries
4. If geometries not required, or all geometries provided, open blank new message template

The `activity` contains details of what template it uses.
